title: Muvaki Akasimba weRuponeso
intro: Munhu uyu ane mwoyo murefu mukuru uye chivimbo chisingazununguki, akatsaurira makore asingaverengeki kubasa raMwari, achitarisana nekushorwa nekurambwa kusingaperi. Nyaya yavo iuchapupu hwakasimba hwekutenda pasinei nekusatenda kukuru, zvichiguma nechiitiko chakakosha chakachinja nyika.
clues: Ndakatsaurira nguva yakareba zvikuru muhupenyu hwangu ndichidana vanhu vangu kuti vanamate Allah.
Vanhu vangu vakandiseka uye vakandipomera mhosva yekukanganisa uye kupenga.
Ndakarayirwa kuti ndivake chimwe chinhu chaiita sechisingawanzoitiki munharaunda yangu isina gungwa.
Vashoma chete ndivo vakatenda uye vakabatana neni nemhuri yangu pakuvaka uku kwakasiyana.
Ndakatakura mapeya ezvisikwa zvese zvipenyu muchikepe, sezvandakarairwa naAllah.
Mafashamo makuru akafukidza nyika, achiponesa chete avo vaiva neni muchikepe changu, nepo mwanakomana wangu akafa nekuda kwekusatenda kwake.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
